title: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2610.29073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought (RE-ZS-CoT), a prompting framework that systematically integrates domain-specific expert roles to enhance reasoning in large language models (LLMs) without task-specific examples. We assess two versions of our approach. In the first version, static role selection, we evaluate eight predefined expert roles across arithmetic, commonsense, and reading comprehension benchmarks to determine their impact on reasoning performance. In the second version, dynamic role selection, each model autonomously selects the single most suitable role for each benchmark, enabling adaptive task-role alignment without manual specification. Across 20 LLMs and seven benchmarks, RE-ZS-CoT frequently surpasses zero-shot and zero-shot-CoT baselines, achieving performance improvements of up to 44 percentage points. translated_title: 角色增强零样本思维链提示的大规模评估
translated_abstract: 本文提出了角色增强零样本思维链（Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought，RE-ZS-CoT），这是一种提示框架，通过系统性地整合特定领域的专家角色来增强大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，且无需任务特定的示例。我们评估了该方法的两个版本。在第一个版本（静态角色选择）中，我们在算术、常识和阅读理解基准上评估了八个预定义的专家角色，以确定它们对推理性能的影响。在第二个版本（动态角色选择）中，每个模型自主地为每个基准选择最合适的单一角色，从而在无需人工指定的情况下实现自适应的任务-角色对齐。在20个大语言模型和七个基准测试上，RE-ZS-CoT经常超越零样本和零样本思维链基线，实现了高达44个百分点的性能提升。研究结果揭示了静态与动态版本之间的强对应关系。
tldr: 本文提出RE-ZS-CoT提示框架，通过静态与动态专家角色选择机制增强大语言模型的零样本推理能力，在20个模型和七个基准上最高取得44个百分点的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RE-ZS-CoT, a prompting framework that enhances LLM zero-shot reasoning through static and dynamic expert role selection, achieving improvements of up to 44 percentage points across 20 LLMs and seven benchmarks.
